title: Glad
html_source:
A literal interpretation: She was glad after,
than/compared to her prior dread!

“the new bloomsday book, A Guide Through Ulysses. 3rd Ed. Harry Blamires; page 147 ”-
‘she is concerned about what his mourning suit signifies, until he reassures her’.

This is difficult to interpret. Possibly, Nurse Callan sees Bloom in a mourning suit and thinks Molly or Milly have passed away. She makes a statement referring to close family and he explains it was an acquaintance whose funeral he attended this morning. She sighs or gestures an indication of relief. It’s challenging to envision her celebrating the fact Dignam died.
